---
title: "Studies"
---

<div class="phase-banner" id="phase">Join a session to see which studies are yours. All studies are readable.</div>
<p><label><input type="checkbox" id="mine-only"> Show only my group's studies</label></p>
<div id="cards"></div>

<script>
(async function () {
  const { rpc, store, el, watchSession } = Lab;
  const cards = await (await fetch("js/cards.json")).json();
  let mine = [], reveals = {};
  const root = document.getElementById("cards");

  function render() {
    const onlyMine = document.getElementById("mine-only").checked;
    root.replaceChildren(...cards.filter(c => !onlyMine || mine.includes(c.id)).map(c => {
      const card = el("article", { class: "card" + (mine.includes(c.id) ? " mine" : ""), id: c.id });
      card.append(el("h3", {}, `Study ${c.label}: ${c.public_title}`, mine.includes(c.id) ? el("span", { class: "badge", style: "margin-left:.5rem" }, "your group") : null));
      card.append(el("div", { class: "meta" }, c.kind));
      card.append(el("div", { html: c.card_html }));
      if (c.figure) card.append(el("figure", {}, el("img", { src: c.figure.path, alt: c.figure.alt || "" }), el("figcaption", { class: "meta" }, c.figure.caption || "")));
      const r = reveals[c.id];
      if (r) {
        const dl = el("dl", {});
        for (const [k, v] of [["Citation", r.citation], ["Authors", r.authors], ["Affiliations", r.affiliations], ["Funding", r.funding], ["Relationship to the technology", r.relationships]])
          if (v) dl.append(el("dt", {}, k), el("dd", {}, v));
        if (r.url) dl.append(el("dt", {}, "Link"), el("dd", {}, el("a", { href: r.url, target: "_blank" }, r.url)));
        card.append(el("div", { class: "reveal" }, el("strong", {}, "Revealed source"), dl));
      }
      return card;
    }));
  }
  document.getElementById("mine-only").onchange = render;
  render();

  watchSession(async sess => {
    const g = store.get().group_code;
    mine = (sess.groups && sess.groups[g]) || [];
    document.getElementById("mine-only").checked = mine.length > 0;
    document.getElementById("phase").textContent = mine.length ? `Group ${g}: your studies are ${mine.map(id => (cards.find(c => c.id === id) || {}).label).join(" and ")}.` : Lab.PHASE_TEXT[sess.phase];
    try {
      const rv = await rpc("get_reveals", { p_join_code: sess.join_code });
      reveals = Object.fromEntries(rv.map(r => [r.study_id, r]));
    } catch { reveals = {}; }
    render();
  });
})();
</script>
